name: 正时（皮带/链条）更换周期

map.选择车型，输入当前里程与上次更换里程，计算剩余更换里程与预估时间: Select the model, enter current mileage and last replacement mileage to compute the remaining replacement distance and projected time
map.下次更换里程 = 上次更换里程 + 厂建议间隔里程: Next replacement mileage = last replacement mileage + factory recommended interval
map.剩余里程 = max(0, 下次更换里程 − 当前里程): Remaining mileage = max(0, next replacement mileage − current mileage)
map.使用进度 = (当前里程 − 上次更换里程) ÷ 厂建议间隔里程 × 100%: Usage progress = (current mileage − last replacement mileage) ÷ factory interval × 100%
map.剩余天数 = 剩余里程 ÷ 日均里程: Remaining days = remaining mileage ÷ average daily mileage
map.说明：正时链条（厂建议间隔 = 0）设计免维护，仅定期检查张紧器与导板；正时皮带: Note: timing chains (factory interval = 0) are designed maintenance-free and only need periodic checks of the tensioner and guides; timing belts are replaced on whichever comes first, mileage or years, because breakage bends the valves and requires an engine rebuild.
map.• 断裂会导致发动机顶气门，损坏严重: • Breakage bends engine valves, causing severe damage
map.（设计寿命与发动机同寿）: (designed to last as long as the engine)
map.• 极少断裂，但可能拉长跳齿: • Rarely breaks, but can stretch and jump teeth
map.一般日系（丰田/本田/马自达）多采用正时链条，免维护；欧系（大众/标致/雪铁龙）: Japanese makers (Toyota / Honda / Mazda) mostly use maintenance-free timing chains, while some European models (VW / Peugeot / Citroën) use timing belts that need periodic replacement. Always follow the vehicle manual.
map.怠速时皮带区域出现刺耳尖叫或拍打声，可能皮带松弛或磨损。: A piercing squeal or flapping from the belt area at idle may mean a slack or worn belt.
map.皮带跳齿导致配气正时偏移，点火不准、加速无力。: A jumped tooth shifts valve timing, giving poor ignition and weak acceleration.
map.皮带可见裂纹 / 老化: Visible cracks / aging on the belt
map.目视检查发现橡胶硬化、龟裂、边缘起毛，应立即更换。: Replace immediately if inspection shows hardened, cracked or frayed rubber.
map.发动机渗油侵蚀橡胶会加速皮带老化，需先治漏再换带。: Oil leaks attacking the rubber accelerate aging; fix the leak before fitting a new belt.
map.链条拉长导致正时偏差，ECU 报故障码，常见于高里程链条车型。: A stretched chain skews timing and the ECU stores a fault code, common on high-mileage chain engines.
map.🚨 正时皮带断裂属灾难性故障，会导致活塞与气门相撞，发动机大修费用高昂。达到更换: 🚨 A snapped timing belt is catastrophic: pistons strike valves and the engine rebuild is expensive. Replace it on schedule and never gamble.
map.📖 常见车型更换周期数据库: 📖 Replacement Interval Database for Common Models
map.车主输入车型与当前里程、上次更换里程，估算正时皮带剩余更换里程，预防断裂顶气门。: Owners enter model, current mileage and last replacement mileage to estimate remaining belt life and prevent a snap that bends valves.
map.二手车过户时核对保养记录，确认皮带/链条是否在厂建议周期内，避免隐形隐患。: On a used-car purchase, check service records to confirm the belt/chain is still within the factory interval and avoid hidden risk.
map.维修排程中，把正时件与水泵（常同轴）一并规划，减少重复拆装工时。: When planning repairs, schedule timing parts together with the water pump (often on the same shaft) to avoid duplicating labor.
map.按里程与时间双约束: Under both mileage and time limits
map.某车正时皮带厂建议 10 万公里或 7 年（先到为准），上次更换里程 80000: A timing belt rated for 100,000 km or 7 years (whichever comes first) was last replaced at 80,000 km six years ago and the car now reads 150,000 km: it is 50,000 km past the interval and close to 7 years, so replace immediately and consider doing the water pump and tensioner pulley at the same time.
map.皮带和链条更换周期差多少？: How far apart are belt and chain intervals?

map.寿命更长（常称免维护，但非永久），多以 20 万公里为参考并靠异响/拉长判断。皮: chains last much longer (often called maintenance-free, though not forever), with 200,000 km a common reference judged by noise or elongation. A snapped belt bends valves and must be replaced on schedule; chains are judged by condition monitoring.
map.为什么常建议连水泵一起换？: Why is replacing the water pump at the same time usually advised?
map.水泵与正时皮带常同轴或同舱，拆装重叠度高，单独换皮带后不久水泵漏液又要大拆，不如: The water pump usually shares the shaft or housing with the timing belt, so labor overlaps heavily; if you change only the belt and the pump leaks soon after, you pay for another full teardown. Doing both at once saves money overall and lowers the risk of a repeat failure.
map.更换周期仅供参考，请以车辆保养手册与实际车况为准: Replacement intervals are reference only; follow the service manual and actual vehicle condition
map.正时皮带/链条更换周期工具内置 12 款常见车型发动机的正时系统类型与更换里程数: The timing belt/chain interval tool has a built-in database of 12 common engine models with timing system type and replacement mileage; enter current mileage to get remaining replacement mileage and the due date, plus belt failure warning signs.
map.如何使用正时（皮带/链条）更换周期: How to use Timing (Belt / Chain) Replacement Interval
map.选择车型并输入当前里程、上次更换里程与年均里程，点击计算即可得到正时皮带剩余更换: Select the model and enter current mileage, last replacement mileage and annual mileage, then click Calculate to get the remaining timing belt replacement mileage and due reminder.
map.正时皮带多为橡胶件，厂建议 6–12 万公里或 5–7 年更换；正时链条设计寿命: Timing belts are rubber parts, usually replaced every 60,000-120,000 km or 5-7 years; timing chains are designed to last much longer (often called maintenance-free, though not forever), with 200,000 km a common reference judged by noise or elongation. A snapped belt bends valves and must be replaced on schedule; chains are judged by condition monitoring.
map.下表按上方输入的当前里程、上次更换里程与年均里程，一次性算出所有车型的保养状态，: The table below computes the service status of every model at once from the current mileage, last replacement mileage and annual mileage above, for easy side-by-side comparison.
map.下次更换里程 = 基准里程 + 厂建议间隔（基准取上次更换里程，上次未填（0）时: Next replacement mileage = base mileage + manufacturer-recommended interval (base is the last replacement mileage, starting from 0 when it was not filled in; the interval is looked up in the recommendation table for the selected model, and for chain-drive models with a 0 interval the maintenance-free branch is used, showing a note only without mileage calculation). Validation: all mileage inputs are treated as non-negative (max(0, value)).
map.剩余里程 = max(0, 下次更换里程 − 当前里程)，负值截 0 表示已超期: Remaining mileage = max(0, next replacement mileage − current mileage); negative values are clamped to 0 to indicate overdue. Validation: current mileage and last replacement mileage are both treated as non-negative. Criterion: remaining mileage ≤ 0 is judged 'overdue, replace immediately' with a note that it exceeds the due point by current mileage − next replacement mileage km.
map.使用进度 = (当前里程 − 基准里程) ÷ 厂建议间隔 × 100%，封顶 1: Usage progress = (current mileage − base mileage) ÷ manufacturer-recommended interval × 100%, capped at 100% (the base mileage follows the same definition as the next replacement mileage, starting from 0 when not filled in). Validation: no strict checks; negative mileage is clamped to 0. Criterion: remaining mileage ≤ interval × 10% is marked 'due soon' (warning color), otherwise 'normal'.
map.日均里程 = 年均里程 ÷ 365（年均里程缺省按 15000，输入强制至少 1: Daily mileage = annual mileage ÷ 365 (annual mileage defaults to 15000, is forced to at least 1, and is clamped with max(1, value) to prevent division by zero). Validation: no strict checks; non-numeric input falls back to the default. Criterion: the larger the daily mileage, the shorter the remaining days for the same remaining mileage; it is only a time-buffer conversion.
